question: What is the meaning of building physics in relation to physical properties, technical properties?
description: Building physics in relation to physical properties and technical properties refers to the study and understanding of how buildings interact with their environment in terms of energy efficiency, thermal performance, ventilation, air tightness, and other related factors. It encompasses the physical aspects of buildings that impact their overall performance and sustainability, focusing on elements such as heat transfer coefficient, thermal mass, absorption, thermal conductivity, and heat protection.
